note: A synthetic client (Slice 115 mock). Not a real company.
problem: We roast specialty coffee and sell 2,000 bags a month through cafés. We want to know whether to launch a direct-to-consumer coffee subscription next year.

answers.common.decision: Launch the subscription or not; the founder decides in January.
answers.common.materials: A bag sells to cafés at $11 and costs us $6 to roast and pack. We have 3,000 people on our newsletter. We have never sold online.
answers.consulting.current-state: Cafés reorder monthly. Two of our largest café customers asked whether we would undercut them online.
answers.consulting.success: A subscription that pays for itself within a year without losing café accounts.
